abstract.t: This document defines the mapping of the RESTful Provisioning Protocol (RPP) to the HTTP protocol. RPP is used for the provisioning and management of objects in a shared database. The RPP data model, consisting of Data Objects and their operations, is defined in [I-D.ietf-rpp-data-objects]. This document specifies how those Data Objects and operations are mapped to HTTP resources, methods, header fields, and status codes, and how RPP servers are discovered. The mapping is independent of the data format used to represent RPP messages.
